boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified, under-21-friendly places in Kansas City where general access or admission is explicitly free.

cards.title: Browse Greenlease Gallery
cards.subtitle: Rockhurst University campus
cards.notes: Visit the permanent religious-art collection and rotating contemporary exhibitions; check the published hours before walking over from campus.
cards.short_summary: A free campus gallery pairing historic and contemporary work.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenlease Gallery and Panacea Project Space are free and open to the public during published hours while the university is in session.
cards.access_notes: Free public access Thursday through Sunday, 1–5 p.m., while Rockhurst is in session; verify seasonal hours.

cards.title: Wander the Nelson-Atkins galleries
cards.subtitle: 4525 Oak St. · Kansas City
cards.notes: Check in for general admission, then choose a gallery wing and take your time with the collection; special exhibitions can have separate tickets.
cards.short_summary: Free general-admission galleries spanning thousands of years of art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson-Atkins states that admission is free every day for everyone, with check-in required for gallery entry.
cards.source_title: Plan your visit to The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; complete the required in-person or online check-in. Paid parking and special exhibitions are optional extras.

cards.title: Walk the Donald J. Hall Sculpture Park
cards.subtitle: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art · Kansas City
cards.notes: Make a daylight lap through the outdoor sculptures and lawns, then pause at a work that catches your eye before continuing your walk.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor sculpture setting at the Nelson-Atkins.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson-Atkins identifies the Donald J. Hall Sculpture Park as free to visit and open from sunrise to sundown.
cards.source_title: Plan your visit to The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Free from sunrise to sundown; stay on public paths and observe posted museum rules.

cards.title: See contemporary art at Kemper
cards.subtitle: 4420 Warwick Blvd. · Kansas City
cards.notes: Drop into the galleries during open hours and focus on one exhibition or a few collection works; confirm the day’s schedule before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary-art museum with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Kemper Museum of Contemporary Art lists admission as always free.
cards.source_title: Kemper Museum of Contemporary Art | Visit KC
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; Visit KC lists Wednesday and Friday–Sunday daytime hours plus Thursday evening hours.

cards.title: Explore the Money Museum
cards.subtitle: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City · 1 Memorial Dr.
cards.notes: Walk through the self-guided exhibits, including currency processing and the gold bar; adults should bring the required government-issued photo ID.
cards.short_summary: A free, self-guided look at currency and the regional Federal Reserve Bank.
cards.evidence_claim: The Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City describes the Money Museum as free, walk-in, self-guided, and requiring no tickets or admission.
cards.source_title: Money Museum - Kansas City - Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 9:30 a.m.–4 p.m.; last entry 3:30 p.m. Security screening applies, and guests 18+ need valid photo ID.

cards.entity_name: Corinthian Hall at The Museum of Kansas City
cards.title: Explore Corinthian Hall
cards.subtitle: 3218 Gladstone Blvd. · Kansas City
cards.notes: Take a self-paced pass through the exhibits and historic rooms, then use the Billiard Room’s games, cards, or reading spaces during your visit.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic mansion with free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Museum of Kansas City states that general admission is free and includes Corinthian Hall exhibits, amenities, and historic grounds.
cards.source_title: Hours & Location – The Museum of Kansas City
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; the museum lists Thursday–Sunday public hours. Programs may have separate tickets.

cards.entity_name: Bruce R. Watkins Cultural Heritage Center & State Museum
cards.title: Visit the Watkins Cultural Heritage Center
cards.subtitle: 3700 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd. · Kansas City
cards.notes: Spend time with the permanent and rotating exhibits, then browse the resource library; plan the visit within the center’s Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.short_summary: A free cultural center and museum focused on African-American heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bruce R. Watkins Cultural Heritage Center & State Museum states that admission is free and that it is open to visitors of all ages.
cards.source_title: Admission | Bruce R. Watkins Cultural Heritage Center & State Museum
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; listed hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m. Verify event or holiday changes before visiting.

cards.title: Take a walk through Loose Park
cards.subtitle: 5100 Wornall Rd. · Kansas City
cards.notes: Walk the park’s paths and take in the municipal rose garden and Civil War markers; keep food and picnics out of the Rose Garden.
cards.short_summary: A 74-acre city park with gardens and historic markers.
cards.evidence_claim: Kansas City Parks lists Loose Park’s hours as 5 a.m. to midnight daily, and Visit KC lists admission as free.
cards.source_title: Loose Park - Kansas City Parks & Recreation
cards.access_notes: Open 5 a.m.–midnight daily. The city’s rules prohibit alcohol on public property and prohibit food or picnics in the Rose Garden.

cards.title: Tour the Hallmark Visitors Center
cards.subtitle: 290 E 25th St. · Crown Center
cards.notes: Follow the self-guided displays through Hallmark history, then watch the bow-making machine and browse the featured exhibitions without buying anything.
cards.short_summary: A free, self-guided look at Hallmark’s Kansas City history and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit KC states that the Hallmark Visitors Center is free to visit and lists free admission.
cards.access_notes: Free admission; Visit KC lists Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m. Group reservations are recommended for groups of 15 or more on weekdays.

cards.entity_name: Model Train Gallery at Union Station
cards.title: Watch the Model Train Gallery
cards.subtitle: Union Station Kansas City · 30 W. Pershing Rd.
cards.notes: Trace the miniature rail scenes and moving trains, then explore the station’s public historic spaces; skip ticketed attractions to keep the visit free.
cards.short_summary: A free Union Station gallery of detailed model railroads and rail history.
cards.evidence_claim: Union Station describes the Model Train Gallery as a free-to-visit 8,000-square-foot exhibit and lists both Union Station and the gallery as free.
cards.source_title: Family Fun in Kansas City | Union Station
cards.access_notes: The Model Train Gallery is free to visit. Union Station also lists ticketed attractions, so remain in the free public areas and gallery.
